contexts.text: These things signified, in the Ancient Church.
What the dreams signified was insinuated.
They thought only about what (the objects) signified and represented.
No idea of such things is in Heaven, but of the Things signified by them.
When the significative Church ceased (all these things) became representative.
The historicals representative, the several words significative. AC 1404. AC 1407. AC 1408. AC 1409. AC 1783. AC 2075:end. AC 2607.
The things thus signified were collected from their lips... and formed into doctrinals, (which) with the Ancient Church, were significative. (Continued. See Represent.)

As all the historicals of the Word are representative, it follows that all the words of the Word are significative, that is, they have a different signification in the internal sense from that which they have in the sense of the letter.
The signification is according to the... predication. AC 3256.
From this perceptive arose the significative, and from this the representative.
(Spirits) know the various meanings of words, applying them in a moment.
The general signification applies itself to the Thing treated of.
Lands, etc. take their signification from their inhabitants.
Under Series, see this reference.
(The idea is apprehended best when no attention is paid to the words or their signification.)
Every animal has its special signification.
Almost all significations (have an opposite sense).
The Ancients... knew from traditions and collections that these things were signified, and because they were significative they accounted them holy.
All things they (sensated) were representative and significative to them.
(In the Word) each Thing represents, and each word signifies.
The things which signify serve also for a comparison. See AC 3901.
Books of that time were nearly all written by significatives; but the significatives have been so obliterated...
Hence their varying significations.
With the Ancients, all fruits and flowers were significative.
Canticles is full of significatives from books of the Ancient Church.
Under Number, see this reference.
Names and Things have different significations in the different senses. Example(s).
(The signification is according to the subject.)
The signification grows mild as it ascends.
The signification known from the series.
Words, in the Original, signify Things. Explained.
The interior significatives of words originate mostly from the interior man...
Many persons... signify various things, but in one person.
The signification of many things is relative.
One word sometimes signifies many things. Explained.
The one involves the signification of the other.
How significations vary. Explained.
There are words which constantly signify good, words which constantly signify truth, and words which signify both; and, if they do not signify them, they are predicated of, or involve them.
The significations of (Scripture) names are perceived in Heaven without instruction.
The significations in the internal sense are unlimited. Explained.
By the hieroglyphics they signified spiritual things.

If it is called a significative, it is understood, but in a sense quite different from a correspondent significative; (for) a spiritual or correspondent significative is conjoined with that to which it corresponds, as the sight is with the eye, etc.
The significatives in the Word are accommodated to the thing represented, the signification which properly belongs to the word still remaining. Example(s).
All things which appear in their habitations are significatives of spiritual things.
All the representatives in nature relate to the human form, and signify according to their relation to it.
Cicero was highly delighted that all (Scripture) names and words should signify interior things.
He signified it, sending by His Angel () = the things revealed through Heaven. AE 8, Explained.
Represented, and thence signified.

Whatever the Lord did in the world, represented; and whatever He spoke, signified. The reason He was in representatives and significatives then, was that He might be in the ultimates of Heaven and the Church and in their primes at the same time... Representatives and significatives are in ultimates.
In the Third Heaven it is known what the very letters signify.
